item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Gwen Stefani Sweet Escape Demos
item.description:
Hi! Just wondering if anyone managed to save the demo versions of Fluorescent, Wonderful Life, and U Started It. They were available for quite some time starting in late 2024, but after DBree closed and UMG filed a complaint against the YouTube videos, they seem to have been wiped off the internet. In particular, I remember the U Started It having heavenly adlibbed vocals in the back during the second bridge.

Thank you in advance!
